EmailTemplate.description: Email to opportunity owner when GEC requires more information
EmailTemplate.name: MINDS Opportunity Clarifying Questions AR
EmailTemplate.subject: Additional questions for your SFDC Opportunity ID {!Opportunity.Id} Account Name {!Account.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Opportunity.OwnerFullName},
Thank you for completing the MAG Questionnaire for your MAG opportunity referenced in the subject line. GEC (Global Export Compliance) has completed the initial review and has additional questions. Please provide your response in SFDC: {!Opportunity.Core_Org_URL__c}apex/Core_MAGQuestionnaire?OpportunityID={!Opportunity.Id}.
Global Export Compliance / GTT Export.customer@intel.com
